label: SPE
description: Arm Statistical Profiling Extension (SPE) 寄存器

registers.name: PMSCR_EL2
registers.description: SPE 控制寄存器 EL2。控制 SPE 在 EL2 的使能和虚拟化支持。FEAT_SPE 时存在。

fields.name: EnVM
fields.description: [When FEAT_SPE_nVM is implemented] 使能 use of 物理地址 Profiling Buffer pointers. If EL2 is 禁用 in the owning Security state, or the Profiling Buffer owning Exception level is EL2, then the Effective value of this field is 1. [0b0=; 0b1=]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: KE
fields.description: [When FEAT_SPE_EXC is implemented] Kernel exception enable for SPE Profiling exceptions taken to EL2. [0b0=; 0b1=]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: EE
fields.description: [When FEAT_SPE_EXC is implemented] Exception 使能. 若 Effective value of MDCR_EL3.PMSEE is 0b00, then the Effective value of PMSCR_EL2.EE is 0b00. 否则, if EL2 is not implemented or the Effective value of SCR_EL3.{NS, EEL2} is {0, 0}, then the Effective value of PMSCR_EL2.EE is 0b01. [0b00=; 0b01=; 0b10=; 0b11=]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: PCT
fields.description: Physical Timestamp. If timestamp sampling is 使能, determines which 计数er is collected. The behavior depends on the Profiling Buffer owning Exception level. If FEAT_ECV is implemented, this is a two-bit field as shown. 否则, bit[7] is RES0. All other values are reserved. If EL2 is not implemented or EL2 is 禁用 in the current Security state, then the Effective value of this field is 0b01, other than for a direct read of the register. [0b00=; 0b01=; 0b11=]

fields.name: TS
fields.description: Timestamp packet sample enable. 使能s recording of Timestamp packets when the Profiling Buffer owning Exception level is EL2. 若 Profiling Buffer owning Exception level is EL1, then this field is ignored by the PE. For more information, see Controlling the data that is collected. When Timestamp packet recording is 使能, recording of End packets is 禁用. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: PA
fields.description: Physical Address packet sample enable. 使能s recording of Physical Address packets when the Profiling Buffer owning Exception level is EL2. 若 Profiling Buffer owning Exception level is EL2, then this field determines whether Physical Address packets are recorded. 若 Profiling Buffer owning Exception level is EL1, and EL2 is 使能 in the owning Security state, then this field is combined with PMSCR_EL1.PA to determine whether Physical Address packets are recorded. If EL2 is not implemented or EL2 is 禁用 in the owning Security state, then the Effective value of this field is 1. For more information, see Controlling the data that is collected. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: CX
fields.description: CONTEXTIDR_EL2 Context packet sample enable. 使能s recording of Context packets containing 值 CONTEXTIDR_EL2. The PE 忽略 值 this field and CONTEXTIDR_EL2 Context packets are not recorded when EL2 is not implemented or EL2 is 禁用 in the current Security state. For more information, see Controlling the data that is collected. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: E0HSPE
fields.description: EL0 SPE 使能。 若 Effective value of HCR_EL2.TGE is 0, then this field is ignored by the PE. [0b0=; 0b1=]
